name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Native Select (a real <select>). Drawn like the kit Select trigger: a 2px ink line on paper and a brush chevron (mark-chevron) in place of the stock icon. Hover thickens the line (G3, fields); focus thickens it to 3px with a paper gap and an ink ring; aria-invalid gives an accent line, a "!" mark before the chevron and a serrated bottom edge; disabled gives a dashed line and a tone frame with the label on paper and a not-allowed cursor. Sizes default and sm, both 44px tall under 640px. The options keep the browser's native popup.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/native-select". It wraps your own components/ui/native-select, so Radix and Base UI both work. className goes on the wrapper (as in the stock component); every other prop goes on the <select>.

meta.tagline: A real select, drawn in ink with a brush chevron.
meta.usage:
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/manga/native-select"

<NativeSelect defaultValue="rtl">
  <NativeSelectOption value="rtl">Right to left</NativeSelectOption>
  <NativeSelectOption value="ltr">Left to right</NativeSelectOption>
</NativeSelect>

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size (44px tall under 640px either way).

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: The error look: accent line, "!" mark, serrated bottom edge.

props.name: NativeSelectOptGroup
props.description: A labelled group of options (native optgroup).

props.name: NativeSelectOption
props.description: One option of the list, with the browser's native popup.
